title: Microsoft’s AI Revenue is 70% OpenAI
excerpt: Microsoft booked $24.1 billion tied to OpenAI, a company that still hasn’t turned a profit and just delayed going public.
content_html:
BREAKING NEWS

Our analysts just identified a stock with the potential to be the next Nvidia. Tell us how you invest and we'll show you why it's our #1 pick. Tap here.

OpenAI has always been a little cagey about its revenue.

Whenever the subject comes up, as it did in late July with CFO Sarah Friar, it gets handled colloquially, presumably to give off the vibe that everything is fine.

"Q2 was no slouch," Friar told OpenAI staffers internally, according to a partial transcript of the meeting reviewed by CNBC.

Notice that Friar never reports an actual number. The last time anyone at the company did was late February 2026, when it put out roughly $25 billion in ARR, or about $2 billion a month. That disclosure got picked apart once it emerged the company had an operating loss of around $7 billion for the quarter.

Sam Altman handles the same subject differently. Asked about it on the BG² Pod in early November 2025, OpenAI's CEO told host Brad Gerstner he would personally find a buyer for his shares if he wanted to sell. Enough, essentially.

Which makes Microsoft's recent filing that much more anxiety-inducing. OpenAI accounts for roughly 70% of Microsoft's AI revenue, with $24.1 billion in sales tied to the company for the fiscal year ending in June, a massive chunk of the $37 billion annualized AI run rate that CEO Satya Nadella keeps touting.

One stock. Nvidia-level potential. 30M+ investors trust Moby to find it first. Get the pick. Tap here.

A company spokesperson told Bloomberg the figure covers "all sales" and "revenue share" from OpenAI, which could mean the revenue-sharing agreement, or OpenAI paying for Azure infrastructure like any other customer, or "other Microsoft services" that nobody has bothered to define.

None of this has to be clear, because OpenAI has yet to IPO and has pushed going public to sometime in 2027. Altman reportedly held off watching the SpaceX listing get taken apart, evidence that markets are currently punishing companies making long-term infrastructure bets in favor of short-term quarterly profits.

That, and OpenAI isn't turning a profit.

The company projects it will be cash flow positive by 2030 at the earliest, and only if it generates $270 billion to $280 billion annually to outpace its spending, per The Information in February 2026. Set that beside a projected cumulative cash burn north of $600 billion through 2030 and it gets hard to take Microsoft's "recorded sales" language at face value. OpenAI is running on continuous mega-rounds from non-Microsoft investors like Thrive, SoftBank, MGX, and Nvidia.

So what happens to Nadella's $37 billion when the equity checks stop clearing?

OpenAI 对其收入一直持谨慎态度。

每当这个话题出现时，就像七月底与首席财务官莎拉·弗里尔(Sarah Friar)谈论的那样，它都会以通俗的方式处理，大概是为了给人一种一切都很好的感觉。

根据 CNBC 看到的部分会议记录，Friar 在内部对 OpenAI 员工表示：“第二季度的表现并不逊色。”

请注意，Friar 从不报告实际数字。 该公司最后一次这样做是在 2026 年 2 月下旬，当时该公司支出了约 250 亿美元的 ARR，即每月约 20 亿美元。 当该公司本季度运营亏损约 70 亿美元时，这一披露就被驳回了。

萨姆·奥尔特曼以不同的方式处理同一主题。 2025 年 11 月上旬，在 BG² Pod 上被问及此事时，OpenAI 的首席执行官告诉主持人布拉德·格斯特纳（Brad Gerstner），如果他想出售他的股票，他会亲自寻找买家。 基本上，足够了。

这使得微软最近的文件更加令人焦虑。 OpenAI 约占微软人工智能收入的 70%，在截至 6 月的财年中，该公司的销售额为 241 亿美元，这在首席执行官 Satya Nadella 不断吹捧的 370 亿美元年度人工智能运行率中占很大一部分。

一只股票。 Nvidia 级别的潜力。 超过 3000 万投资者相信 Moby 能够首先找到它。 得到选秀权。 点击此处。

一位公司发言人告诉彭博社，这一数字涵盖了 OpenAI 的“所有销售额”和“收入分成”，这可能意味着收入分享协议，或者 OpenAI 像任何其他客户一样为 Azure 基础设施付费，或者没有人费心去定义“其他微软服务”。

这些都不必明确，因为 OpenAI 尚未进行 IPO，并将上市时间推迟到 2027 年。 据报道，奥特曼没有观看 SpaceX 的上市被拆散，这表明市场目前正在惩罚那些为了短期季度利润而进行长期基础设施押注的公司。

但 OpenAI 并没有实现盈利。

据 2026 年 2 月的 The Information 报道，该公司预计，最早到 2030 年，现金流将实现正数，而且每年的收入必须达到 2700 亿至 2800 亿美元，超过支出。 再加上到 2030 年预计累计现金消耗将超过 6000 亿美元，很难从表面上理解微软“创纪录的销售”语言。 OpenAI 正在接受 Thrive、软银、MGX 和 Nvidia 等非微软投资者的持续巨额融资。

那么，当股权支票停止清算时，纳德拉的 370 亿美元会怎样呢？
